name: Auberge du Jeu de Paume
positioning: Relais & Chateaux hotel in Louis XV style, just beyond the archway to the Chateau de Chantilly and its estate
best_for: Travelers who want a base beside the Chateau de Chantilly and the Domaine
Travelers looking for a spa stay with signature treatments
Visitors coming to the region for the horse races

facts.text: The hotel is a Relais & Chateaux member and part of SANA Luxury Edition.
The hotel is located just beyond the stone archway that leads to the Chateau de Chantilly and its estate.
The Domaine de Chantilly is spread over 7800 hectares, with historical monuments, prestigious sporting venues and natural landscapes.
The Chateau de Chantilly houses the Conde Museum, with works by European masters such as Raphael, Delacroix, Ingres, Watteau and Poussin.
The hotel has a refined aesthetic in Louis XV style.
Rooms have curtains in navy or burgundy toile de Jouy, Louis XV armchairs and equestrian touches.
Room categories include a Premium Park View Room, Prestige Terrace Rooms and Suites, and an Arc de Triomphe Suite.
Spa Valmont has Moorish-inspired openings onto a relaxation pool, whirlpool, steam room and sauna.
Spa Valmont has a shop and a juice bar.
The hotel has two restaurants, a bar, a spa and salons.
Le Jardin d'Hiver is a chic bistro serving simple and refined French cuisine that gives pride of place to seasonal products.
Guests will find a billiard room and valet parking.

highlights.text: Because the hotel is part of the Domaine, it can organize weddings, celebrations and private dinners inside the Chateau.
The rooms, dining areas, sitting rooms and bars surround a central garden courtyard.
Rooms have views of the Chateau, the park or the hotel's courtyard.
The Valmont Spa has two signature treatments created for the property, including one involving whipped cream body wraps.

considerations.text: The decor is Louis XV in style, with toile de Jouy fabrics and Louis XV armchairs.
Many guests travel to the region for the horse races.
WhataHotel notes that a car or taxi is needed to explore the surrounding area.
